text: A Python project with a requirements.txt at its root gets its own test image, so its tests and checks run with the application's dependencies (#227, #302). The pinned base's own pip parses the requirements and every local file they include, offline and isolated, and its report decides what's accepted: named public-PyPI requirements with hashes as their only options, and includes inside the project. Canonical requirement and constraint files are written from that report, and pip installs only wheels from them, with network only while the image builds. Installed packages are libraries only: none can replace a command or an interpreter the gate runs, or run before the application imports it. Docker's proxy settings never reach a gate container. Checks run offline in one immutable image with a fixed hash seed, and receipts and fingerprints record the original and canonical inputs and every resolved wheel. A dependency the application imports runs as part of the code under test. A project without requirements keeps D-0030's standard-library path.
